_meta.session: Push #24 — HCI-AUDIO canonical sibling created (doctrine-only scaffold). Direct modern descendant of the DADC work in Rogue-Wave-Audio. Doctrine for 4-way psychoacoustic active loudspeaker alignment with ERB-band carriers, quaternion phase mapping, and listening-position diffraction.
_meta.purpose: Canonical home for applied audio work in the Hs system. Sibling of HCI-CNT and HCI-CNQ.

tier.name: HCI-AUDIO
tier.compiled_engine: none (uses HCI-CNT cnt.py as back-end for compositional data)
next_milestones: First pilot measurement against Peter's 4-way system

carriers.effective_dimensionality: 40 bands x 4 drivers = 160 carriers (with sparsity from crossover partitions)

lineage.origin: DADC (Dimension-Apportioned Diffraction Correction) at Binaural Test Lab, Markham (Rogue-Wave-Audio repository)
lineage.fixed_total_old: 6.02 dB diffraction budget on cabinet dimensions (near-field)
lineage.fixed_total_new: perceptual energy arriving at the listening position (real-room conditions)
lineage.closure_principle: preserved (ADAC-style adaptive closure on the simplex)

doctrine_documents.doctrine/ERB_BAND_MAPPING.md: ERB carriers, 40-band recommended config, perceptual weighting
doctrine_documents.doctrine/QUATERNION_PHASE_MAPPING.md: phase + time delay as quaternion / joint quaternion field
doctrine_documents.doctrine/HELMSMAN_AT_LISTENING_POS.md: per-driver, per-band, and joint helmsman extraction
doctrine_documents.doctrine/ALIGNMENT_TARGETS.md: metric definitions for a well-aligned 4-way system

specifications.spec/PSYCHOACOUSTIC_4WAY_ADAPTER_SPEC.md: adapter that takes WAV/measurement -> canonical compositional
specifications.spec/PIPELINE_SPEC.md: how HCI-AUDIO output flows through CNT then CNQ

out_of_scope_for_this_push: live integration with measurement tools (Smaart, REW)
